objectives: 讓同學學習如何做學術論文，並督促同學的碩士論文進度
content:
1. Learning the structure of an academic dissertation
2. Learning how to work on a dissertation in a solid way
3. Learning the rules that students can't violate when working on a dissertation
4. Monitoring the progress of students' dissertations and ensuring no one is left behind
grading_policy:
1. 出席 30%
2. 碩士論文進度 30%
3. 碩士論文進度報告 40%

distribution_conditions.rule: 系所:限財務金融學系碩士班。年級:限二年級。
